title: Charles IX to Jean de Vulcob, 7 March 1573 (Français 3318)

steps.what: George Lasry (with ChatGPT Astra 6 and Anthropic Opus 5.5) transcribed and deciphered the item: Transcribed; Deciphered; 754 elements, 746 identified; 4 groups with unresolved boundaries and 19 null-marked groups. Report section: see report.
